nodes.label: ADR-004: OpenSpec Spec-Driven Development Governance
nodes.rationale: Adopted OpenSpec SDD with mandatory proposal/design/spec/tasks/evidence/archive gates over (a) ad-hoc documentation (no traceability enforcement) and (c) fully formalized specification with formal verification (unsustainable overhead), because the project mandates AI-native delivery traceable from business intent through implementation evidence across multiple concurrent human and agent contributors; a documented exception list keeps trivial changes low-overhead.
